feature: Double-click a track group's name to rename it
summary: Double-clicking a track group's name now opens it for typing and leaves the group open or folded as it was. Before, the double-click folded the group and never opened the name.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a screen recording and add a second video track with the + under the track names.
Pick V2, Shift-click V1, then right-click and choose Group 2 Tracks.
Double-click the name Group 1, type a new name and press Return.
Single-click the group's name and watch it fold a moment later.
Double-click the folded group's name: it opens for typing and stays folded. Press Escape.
Click the chevron: the group opens at once.

evaluate: Does a single click on the name fold soon enough, or does the short wait feel slow?
Is the chevron easy enough to hit when you want a fold with no wait?
Does clicking away from the name field keep what you typed, the way it does for a track's name?
rough: No mock draws a track group, so there was nothing to compare against.
A single click on the name now folds only after your Mac's double-click time (about half a second by default), so a double-click is never taken for a fold. The chevron still folds at once.
The name field now takes the keyboard reliably and keeps the name when you click away, the same as a track's own name field.
